Dear Sirs / Madam, 
  
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Audio recording of Earnings call with analysts and 
investors 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the Earnings call on the Unaudited Standalone and 
Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 held 
with analysts and investors on 30th October 2026, has been uploaded on the Company's 
website at the link: 
 
https://www.camsonline.com/assets/PDF/BSE_Intimations/10047363.mp3 
 
We request you to take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
  
Yours faithfully, 
For Computer Age Management Services Limited 
  
  
 
G Manikandan
